depicts: Close-up of a sculpted ant's head, thorax and legs in blue-and-copper metallic shading against dark grey; legs cross the lower left foreground.
composition: Extreme close-up; thorax fills centre, head cut off at left edge, abdomen cut at bottom right, legs cut at left and right edges. Dark background visible only at top and gaps.
tone_and_contrast: Blue and copper reflections on the metal surface; strong local contrast in surface texture, dark grey background separates well.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Fine wrinkled surface detail is visible. A thin light horizontal line runs across the top edge. Faint stepped facets on the legs at lower left. No watermark.
scan_first_read: A close-up of textured blue metallic ant body; abstract, hard to tell it is an ant at once.
